data.text/markdown:
🔬 Encoder Diagnostics

The scatter plots above are colored by opening prefix — something the encoder was never trained to encode. Its real targets are style (9 features), phase, and tactics. These four cells evaluate what the embedding actually captures. TL;DR from the data: PC1 (45.9% var) is dominated by line depth (nply, r ≈ −0.69, driven by the fullmove-number input plane), so the two big regions are short vs. deep lines — not a style split. The style signal the model learned lives mostly on PC2 (quiet/castled/endgame ↔ tactical/sharp).
